name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt:
Use case: image correction for LH07-0108, catalog version 6. Image 1 controls the original radio anatomy and source geometry. Image 2 is the Japanese edit target. Image 3 controls exact Japanese wording, scale and section positions. Image 4 controls the approved Lighthouse palette.

Recreate the compact 390×284 settings panel. Preserve the existing content and hierarchy exactly. Exact strings: 「時刻の書式」; 「12時間表記（例：午後2:00）」; 「24時間表記（例：14:00）」; 「ウェブ上の説明を表示」; 「空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示」; 「プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ」. First radio and second group radio are selected; second time-format radio is unselected.

At 390×284, restore the section rhythm: first heading y=20, first selected row y=59, second option y=104, first divider y=140, second heading y=171, selected description row y=208, lower divider y=244, footer y=255. Use white canvas and white surfaces, fine neutral dividers, dark headings/body text, gray examples, and a quiet muted footer. Do not add cards, toolbar, buttons, repeated footer or extra whitespace.

Selected radio indicators must use the exact Lighthouse forest-green gradient (#174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E), with the selected center dot and ring visibly contained in the original radio size. Unselected radio stays a neutral gray outline. No flat solid-green selected indicator, colored canvas, tinted surface, arbitrary accent, or glow. Preserve source anatomy, Japanese Meiryo role typography, label sizes, all text, alignment and selected states. Keep the panel at the same aspect ratio and component scale.
reviewNotes: 390x284 review: labels and selected states are legible, but the first heading is low and the second group/footer remain compressed. Selected radios still read as flat green; needs correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
